routes: /settings/roles (real RolesPanel, state, RBACAPI, runtime gate and CSS in isolated HTTP fixture)
states: Locked Playwright 1.56.1, Chromium 141.0.7390.37 and WebKit 26.0; desktop light and narrow dark. Same synthetic roles, viewport, theme and operation before/after. All 36 retained captures were opened using native view_image.

Applied role PUT, POST and DELETE each return fixture 502. Parent keeps the old inventory and a repeat-write dialog; final withdraws the stale snapshot and obsolete confirmation, explains possible application and blocks writes until an accepted read.

Eight cases in each phase: Chromium create/update/delete at both widths, WebKit update at both widths. This is consuming-panel proof with explicit safe HTTP inputs, not installed-account, backend or production-bundle pixel acceptance.
interactions: Exactly one write per case, through the real API client and RBACAPI, with existing organization and CSRF headers. There is no automatic mutation or recovery read.

Update recovery first receives 503; the warning and write fence survive. A subsequent delayed read coalesces double activation and retains the fence until valid inventory. Readback shows audit_logs in the real editor, including on narrow screens.
Creation and deletion recovery use keyboard Enter on the read-only action. Accepted inventory shows the actual created role or confirmed empty list, without replaying a write.

Focus moves from the obsolete dialog to the uncertainty notice. No page errors or horizontal overflow in completed cases. HTTP console errors are deliberately induced fixture 502/503 responses, not hidden failures.
